notes.title: The update for the demo version is now available!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597897/e9b7327a2f33ccb045fef6e6ec81cc72777caf6d.png
Greetings, friends!

The development of the game is progressing as planned, and to make sure you don’t get bored, I decided to update the demo version so it better reflects what I plan to showcase at the final release.

New features have been added, the gameplay has been improved, and minor issues have been addressed. But let’s dive into the details:


 Added the ability to customize controls. 
 Localization added for the following languages: Spanish, Italian, German, Portuguese, French, and Japanese.
 Joy and anger animations have been added for all characters.
 New enemies – Bandits. 
 Added markers to help navigate the game world.
 Destructible objects have appeared in the game world, dropping coins upon destruction.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597897/42a95323334c633dccca4b1df40973866f6189f6.gif
 3 new skins are now available for purchase using coins.
 A huge number of various bugs have been fixed. 
 Significant work on SFX: all missing sounds and ambient effects have been added, while old sounds have been improved and balanced for volume.
 Introduced the Magic Cards mechanic – create one of four items to solve puzzles.
 The alpaca is still drunk.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597897/4de6f68a50c86e4f41cb311647abe3d9f31dc382.gif

Jump in, test it out, and enjoy the updated version!🎮✨

Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1820100/DREAMOUT/
